# Research-report guidance

Reports are bounded research inputs, not active synthesis or evidence authority.
Use [templates/research-report-metadata.md](../../templates/research-report-metadata.md)
and [docs/EVIDENCE_STANDARD.md](../../docs/EVIDENCE_STANDARD.md). Give material
claims claim-specific sources with provenance, version/profile/commit and date
where relevant, freshness, method, exclusions, and limitations. Disclose
material AI assistance and verify its claims and citations independently.
Preserve historical wording when needed for provenance, but make obsolete,
provisional, conflicting, or superseded status unmistakable.
